frozen_decision: Estimated-prior development and both HPC execution-equivalence bridges passed before confirmation freeze. Use original/repaired consensus, equal-prior and observed-X-estimated-prior component-density oracles; privileged known-prior arms remain development-only.
primary_mechanism_endpoint: Per-dataset mean normalized Kendall distance to the three true group orders; compare repaired minus original paired by seed; also retain each group and consensus residuals.
secondary_endpoints: Per-group truth error; observed pair distances; optimizer flags; paired N versus 4N recovery with independent (not nested) samples. Oracle equal and estimated-prior arms illustrate objective, initialization and component-estimation effects and are not inference candidates.
execution_implementation: Direct normal-PDF objective changes only distribution-object construction. Enable after HPC full optimizer/mixture/output exact-equivalence checks and same-seed B3 batch bridge; original/repaired share mixture only within a single identical-input job.
freeze_policy: Immutable source/config snapshot created before any42xxxxxx confirmation data are generated. Earlier41xxxxxx structural-preflight data are excluded. Changes prompted by confirmation outcomes require a new candidate and fresh seeds.
